entities.name: Query protein 197 aa
observations: 197 aa soluble-looking protein with predicted molecular weight 22.26 kDa and theoretical pI 6.53.
Contains a Ham1p_like domain (Pfam PF01725.22) spanning residues 3–191.
Has 61.6% identity over 100% query coverage to reviewed UniProt Q6MF40, annotated as dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase.
Has additional 48%–48.5% full-length homology to reviewed Chlamydia dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Functional assignment is supported by homology and domain evidence, not direct biochemical assay of this exact sequence.

entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated as EC 3.6.1.66 and preferentially hydrolyze noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates XTP, dITP, and ITP.
The enzyme is reported to bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit and form a homodimer.
The proposed biological role is nucleotide-pool sanitization by removing damaged or noncanonical purine triphosphates.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: Chemical reaction: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+; mapped to Rhea RHEA:28610 in curated homolog annotations.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: Chemical reaction: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+; mapped to Rhea RHEA:28342 in curated homolog annotations.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: Chemical reaction: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+; mapped to Rhea RHEA:29399 in curated homolog annotations.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit; this cofactor supports phosphate-group hydrolysis chemistry.
